summary: Robustness epic, Tier 1 (CI/CD) — sprint 2026-W26. A GitHub Actions build+test+scan gate on dev. Wave 1 lands the foundational workflow (Postgres service container + ./mvnw verify); Wave 2 fans out three independent extensions (Maven cache, Dependabot, Trivy scan) that touch separate files/areas; Wave 3 wires enforcement (required status check on dev) once Wave 1's check name is stable. Tier 2/3 are deferred to future sprints.

waves.label: Wave 1 — CI core (foundation)
waves.blurb: The ci.yml workflow with a postgres:16 service container running ./mvnw -B verify, proven green on a PR to dev. Everything else extends this file or depends on its check name.

waves.label: Wave 2 — Independent CI extensions
waves.blurb: Maven cache (#16, edits the workflow), Dependabot (#17, new .github/dependabot.yml), Trivy scan (#18, adds a workflow step). Low mutual conflict; #16/#18 touch ci.yml so coordinate, #17 is fully independent.

waves.label: Wave 3 — Enforce the gate
waves.blurb: Enable required-status-check branch protection on dev via gh api. Depends on Wave 1 — the check name must be stable first.
